MAC-003.2.heading: [MAC-003.2] Validate the minimum OS and entitlement contract
MAC-003.2.evidenceLevel: source-reviewed; no packaged macOS execution in this preparation
alreadyImplemented: Electron is pinned to 39.2.7, whose Electron-level floor is macOS 12. Hardened runtime, JIT/executable-memory/library-validation and microphone entitlements exist.

Microphone and local-network usage descriptions exist. Meeting recorder and dictation use getUserMedia. The schema-3 voice privacy/default/cancel source fixes are present unchanged from d93bd3c3aedac0ce3360c5f460170b2da1a16a94.

Read-only vtool inspection of the existing qualified Bun 1.3.14 darwin-arm64 binary shows LC_BUILD_VERSION platform MACOS, minos 13.0, sdk 15.2. This mandatory bundled runtime already raises the app floor above Electron-only macOS 12.
remainingGaps: No mac.minimumSystemVersion is declared. A provisional floor of at least macOS 13 is source/toolchain-supported, but the final floor must be the maximum across all mandatory target binaries and required features.

Intel Bun/Claude/libSQL/ONNX/Sharp/uv deployment targets and CPU requirements have not been inspected in this preparation. Node 24 is a CI/build host; embedded Electron Node and managed Node 22 are distinct runtimes.

Broad executable-memory/library-validation entitlements are inherited by helpers without inspected per-binary justification. They must be evaluated against real hardened native imports, not removed speculatively.
Microphone description promises all transcription is local while explicit cloud ASR consent exists. Text must accurately describe the available local/default and explicitly selected cloud behavior.

No desktopCapturer/system-audio capture call was found in the inspected Electron source. NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription is therefore a conditional requirement if that capability is enabled, not an observed current missing-microphone fix. Electron 39 CoreAudioTap system-audio capture on macOS 14.2+ requires that description.

concretePatches.change: Compute/document the release minimum from pinned per-target Mach-O minima and supported feature behavior; provisionally expect >=13.0 from bundled Bun, then set minimumSystemVersion to the verified maximum and encode it in receipts/update eligibility. Prevent installation/update on unsupported versions with an actionable message.
